# #8921: admitted brace-elision pairs that are EFFECTIVE AT MORE THAN ONE
# declaring schema site, and WHERE.
#
# Site LISTS, not counts (#9094): a count cannot see a SUBSTITUTION -- a
# pair that loses one declaring site and gains another holds its count
# while the thing this issue is about has changed completely.
#
